name: Carry out routine maintenance of agricultural equipment
description: Perform scheduled servicing, lubrication, cleaning and minor part replacement on farm equipment so that it stays fit for use.

name: Diagnose faults in agricultural machinery
description: Use symptoms, inspection and test instruments to isolate the root cause of a machinery fault before repair.

name: Repair pumps and irrigation equipment
description: Dismantle, repair, reassemble and refit pump sets and irrigation components.

name: Test and commission repaired equipment
description: Verify that repaired equipment meets performance specification using appropriate measurement, and hand it back safely.

name: Carry out advanced repair of engines and power transmission
description: Overhaul small engines, clutches and drive assemblies used on farm equipment.

name: Operate tractors and mounted implements safely
description: Operate a tractor and attach, adjust and use mounted implements without risk to people or equipment.

name: Operate irrigation systems
description: Set up and run surface, sprinkler and drip irrigation systems to a schedule.

name: Perform welding and fabrication for repair work
description: Carry out arc and gas welding to repair or fabricate mechanical parts.

name: Service hydraulic systems
description: Inspect, service and repair hydraulic circuits, cylinders and control valves.

name: Assemble and align mechanical components
description: Fit, align and secure mechanical assemblies to drawing or specification.

name: Install and commission solar pumping systems
description: Site, mount, wire and commission a solar powered pump set.

name: Work safely with electrical equipment
description: Isolate, earth and safely work on electrically powered equipment.

name: Rewind and test electric motors
description: Strip, rewind, varnish and test single and three phase motors.

name: Maintain workplace health and safety
description: Identify hazards, use protective equipment and respond correctly to workplace incidents.

name: Interact with customers and maintain service records
description: Receive work politely, explain the job and cost, and keep accurate service records.

name: Plan and price a small service enterprise
description: Work out costs, set prices and plan the working capital a small repair business needs.

name: Manage spares and inventory
description: Decide what spares to stock, track them and reorder before running out.

name: Handle payments and maintain accounts
description: Accept cash and digital payments, record them and reconcile daily takings.

name: Service two-wheeler engines and transmissions
description: Carry out periodic service and minor repair on motorcycles and scooters.

name: Operate and attend a pump set (superseded)
description: Legacy standard covering basic pump operation. Superseded by AGR/N1103.

name: Write application code in Python and Java
description: Develop modular code, functions, and unit tests in Python and Java according to functional requirements.

name: Build responsive web interfaces and applications
description: Develop client-side components using modern web technologies and frontend frameworks.

name: Manage databases and write structured SQL queries
description: Design relational tables, perform CRUD operations, and write queries in SQL databases.

name: Diagnose IT system faults and assist desktop users
description: Troubleshoot operating systems, peripheral connectivity, hardware errors, and network connections.

name: Operate office systems and perform data entry in Excel
description: Maintain spreadsheets, enter validated records, and produce structured reports.

name: Produce technical drawings using CAD tools
description: Develop 2D engineering schematics, dimensional tolerances, and CAD part models.

name: Record business transactions and ledger entries in Tally
description: Enter debit/credit vouchers, generate trial balances, and process GST filings.
